verdict.rationale: Railway's site makes one brief claim that you can 'run your application closer to where your users are.' That suggests region selection for deployments, not a true global edge network. Nothing describes how many locations exist, routing to the nearest region, or edge-function-style execution. Missing for 10: documentation of a global edge network or point-of-presence footprint, automatic routing of users to the nearest location, multi-region deployment details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
